verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury has a documented public API with an API reference for the FinancialAccount object and documented API objects for OutboundPayment, ReceivedDebit and Transaction, plus webhook events for money movement. A Stripe PM's account of Shopify building Balance on the Treasury API corroborates real-world programmatic use, and the docs are available as machine-readable markdown and llms.txt. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and API-level details such as authentication and rate limits are not shown in the pack.
